name: Tay An Pagoda
kicker: Pagoda on the Sam Mountain walk
summary: Chùa Tây An sits in the Núi Sam cluster with the shrine and the tomb. Vietnam Tourism lists it on the same temple walk as the cave pagoda. A room-by-room description was not on the pages opened, so the visit is the facade and the garden of stupas. The gate fee and a fixed length are check on arrival. Do not skip it only because the shrine next door is more famous.
getThere: On the Sam Mountain road, with the shrine and the tomb.
heroCaption: The facade of Chùa Tây An, with Núi Sam behind the gate
body: Look at the pagoda as part of the morning at the foot of Núi Sam. Vietnam Tourism names Chùa Tây An with the shrine and the cave pagoda. TITC names it with the Thoại Ngọc Hầu tomb and Phước Điền. The building is the stop. A guide to the rooms inside was not on those pages.
The gate in the photograph carries the name Tây An, and the hill is behind it. The second frame is the garden of stupas. Give it the same morning as the shrine. It is not a day by itself.
Hours and a fee were not printed. Check on arrival. The distance from the river wards is the Sam Mountain distance: about 5 km and about 7 km in the same older article. Minutes are check on arrival.

gettingThere: Chùa Tây An is in the Núi Sam cluster in phường Vĩnh Tế, on the same road as Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ. No separate minute count was printed.

legs.body: On foot, as part of the foot-of-the-hill walk. A published walking minute was not found. Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day was published. Check the board on arrival.
